create_prompt_encoder: create a PromptEncoder to encode point, box, and mask prompts for SAM's mask decoder
embed_points_prompt_encoder: embed point prompts with coordinates and labels into sparse embeddings using PromptEncoder._embed_points
embed_boxes_prompt_encoder: embed box prompts into sparse embeddings using PromptEncoder._embed_boxes
embed_masks_prompt_encoder: embed input masks into dense embeddings using PromptEncoder._embed_masks
generate_positional_encoding: generate random spatial positional encodings for a grid using PositionEmbeddingRandom
